mechanics.claim: Naafiri and Packmates channel before dashing, revealing the target in true sight during the channel.
mechanics.quote: channel for {{fd|0.75}} seconds to single out the target enemy champion, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them in the duration

mechanics.claim: Packmates deal a separate, smaller damage instance on the same target as Naafiri's collision damage.
mechanics.quote: whereas each ''Packmate'' deals {{ap|{{#var:rp}}*100}}% of that damage

mechanics.claim: Damage is dealt upon Naafiri's arrival/collision with the target after the dash, not at cast.
mechanics.quote: they {{tip|dash}} to the target; upon arrival '''Naafiri''' deals {{as|physical damage}}

mechanics.claim: A champion takedown within 7 seconds of cast grants a free recast within 12 seconds.
mechanics.quote: If '''Naafiri''' scores a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 7 seconds of cast... she can also recast ''Hounds' Pursuit'' once from triggering this effect within 12 seconds at no cost

mechanics.claim: The recast grants Naafiri a shield before repeating the first cast's damage effects.
mechanics.quote: '''Naafiri''' immediately grants herself a {{tip|shield}} for 3 seconds before mimicking the {{tt|first cast's effects|Excluding the takedown effects, which can trigger only once}}

mechanics.claim: Cooldown begins on cast, not on effect completion.
Spell shield blocks only Naafiri's own collision damage, not the Packmates' damage.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block '''Naafiri's''' collision damage but cannot prevent collision damage from ''Packmates''

mechanics.claim: If Naafiri's channel is interrupted, the Packmates' channels are cancelled as well.
mechanics.quote: If '''Naafiri's''' channel is interrupted, the ''Packmates' '' channels will be canceled as well
